name: Chemchemal-Bazian Gas Pipeline

values.RouteNotes: Announced as a dedicated 40 km line from the Chemchemal field to industrial consumers in the Bazian area; no published GIS route. To be built by (unnamed) private-sector companies.

researcher_notes:
NEW ROW. Passes all three add-threshold legs: (a) sponsor = Pearl Petroleum consortium (Dana Gas + Crescent Petroleum operating) developing the Chemchemal field under a KRG concession; (b) country + endpoints = Iraq, Chemchemal field (Sulaymaniyah) -> Bazian industrial area; (c) concrete step = 10-year Gas Sales Agreements signed Jan 2026 with Bazian-area offtakers (Mass/Bazian/Delta/Gasin/Sulaimani Cement), $160m committed to field development, first gas targeted H2 2027. Corroborated by >=2 independent sources: Crescent Petroleum press release (operator/primary), World Oil (independent trade press), OilPrice analysis, and Iraqi News all confirm a 'dedicated 40 km pipeline' from Chemchemal to Bazian industrial consumers, privately funded, deliveries from H2 2027. All four URLs passed url_verifier (200 + expected content). Confidence: HIGH on existence, endpoints, 40 km length, sponsor, and the Jan-2026 GSA milestone.

MATCH CHECK: Distinct from existing GEM rows. P6823 (Khormor-Pirdawood PP) and P4047 (Khormor-Erbil, construction) are Khor Mor-sourced lines feeding power plants / Erbil; this is a Chemchemal-field-sourced, privately built line to Bazian INDUSTRIAL (cement) consumers. No roster row originates at Chemchemal. Not a duplicate.

DELIBERATE OMISSIONS (skeptical calls): (1) Capacity LEFT BLANK. The widely cited '142 MMscf/d' is the FIELD-WIDE GSA offtake total across ALL new industrial customers (both the Bazian cement cluster AND the separate Erbil line to Van Steel), per World Oil ('up to 142 MMscf/d collectively across all industrial customers'). Assigning the full 142 MMscf/d to the Bazian line alone would overstate it; sources do not disaggregate a per-line rating. (2) Owner LEFT BLANK. Sources say the pipeline is 'to be built by private-sector companies' but name no specific builder/owner entity; did not run/stage a new owner entity. (3) $160m cost NOT attributed to the pipeline — it covers three wells + an extended well test facility + enabling infrastructure for the whole field program, not the pipeline specifically. (4) FIDStatus blank — GSAs are offtake agreements, not a pipeline construction FID. (5) No published GIS route -> RouteAccuracy 'no route'. Sibling candidate 'chemchemal-erbil-industrial-gas' is a separate build (Van Steel offtaker) and is vetted separately.
